title: Native separator paths for Windows fixture and allocation child guards
api_or_output: Normalize construction of owned test paths to native separators; preserve all child capability/provenance/path confinement checks and original fixtures/expectations.

acceptance.description: Five test harnesses construct native-separator paths; all existing strict descendant, canonical path, capability, fingerprint and original oracle assertions remain unchanged.
Focused schema original/hash and four real/positive allocation child checks pass on integrated local source; document actual Windows42 failure and that Windows rerun remains unexecuted.

handoff.summary: Repair mixed separator construction identified by actual Windows hosted failures without changing runtime or skipping tests.
